name: Zimone, Mystery Unraveler
oracle_text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, manifest dread if this is the first time this ability has resolved this turn. Otherwise, you may turn a permanent you control face up. (To manifest dread, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
blocked_sentences: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, manifest dread if this is the first time this ability has resolved this turn. Otherwise, you may turn a permanent you control face up

needs.what: manifest dread (701.62): look at the top two cards of your library, choose one and manifest it (face-down 2/2, turnable face up for its mana cost if a creature card), put the other into your graveyard
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `manifest` op takes only amount, cloak and player and manifests the top card(s) with no choice; it cannot look at two, pick one and send the rest to the graveyard. `look_at_top` has face_down and rest_to, but its face_down does not make a manifested 2/2 that can be turned up for its mana cost, so composing them would be an approximation

needs.what: an effect op that turns a chosen face-down permanent its controller controls face up without paying any cost (optional via `may`), reusing the engine's Game._turn_face_up path so turned-face-up events fire, with the choice limited to face-down permanents you control
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op in `ops` turns a permanent face up; `transform` flips double-faced cards, not face-down morphs/manifests, and the face-up action exists only as the paid special action, not as an effect a resolving ability can perform

needs.what: a selector key matching face-down permanents (`face_down: true`), so 'turn a permanent you control face up' offers only permanents that are face down
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `selector_keys` has no face-down key; `face_down` appears only as an option on look_at_top/reveal_until/search_zones for putting cards onto the battlefield, not as a filter on existing permanents
